claim: Push gossip informs all n nodes in about log2(n) + ln(n) rounds: about 22.5 rounds for n = 10,000.
assumptions: Synchronous rounds; every informed node pushes to one node chosen uniformly at random (itself allowed).
The usual quote drops the paper's O(1) term; the check takes the quote as stated.
plan: Run 2,000 full rumor spreads over 10,000 nodes and average the rounds until everyone knows. The curve is the share informed per round in the first run.
